Lines.Strings: Public BalValue(512) As String ' Balans nomrelerini saxlayan massiv
Public SumBal(12) As String   ' Balans file olan balans nomrelerine uygun qiymetler
For i = 2 To 1000 ' "Pruden.xls" faylinda "Qeydler" sheet-de setrlerin sayi
If Cells(i, 1) = "YOX" Then End ' tam cixish
If Cells(i, 3) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 3, 1 ' "C" balamce
If Cells(i, 4) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 4, 2 ' "D" gelir-zerer
If Cells(i, 5) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 5, 1 ' "E" balance
If Cells(i, 6) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 6, 1 ' "F" balance
If Cells(i, 7) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 7, 3 ' "G" saldo
If Cells(i, 8) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 8, 1 ' "H" balance
If Cells(i, 9) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 9, 3 ' "I" saldo
If Cells(i, 10) <> "YOX" Then Calc i, 10, 4 ' "J" Formula
Function Calc(i, j, File) ' i-current cell, j current cell,File-hansi fayldan oxunacaq
CountBal = ToArray(i, j)                  ' Celss-deki Balans hesablarinin BalValue massivine oxunmasi
d = SumBalance(CountBal)                  ' BalValue massivindeki Balans hesablarinin cemlenerek SumBal masivine yazilmasi
Sum = SumBal(1) + SumBal(2)              ' dovrun evveli ne activ ve passivlerin cemi
Sum = SumBal(5) + SumBal(6)            ' dovrun axiri ne activ ve passivlerin cemi
d = SumGelir(CountBal)                    ' BalValue massivindeki Gelir-Zerer subhesablarin cemlenerek SumBal masivine yazilmasi
d = SumSaldo(CountBal)                    ' BalValue massivindeki Saldo subhesablarin cemlenerek SumBal masivine yazilmasi
Sum = Val(SumBal(11)) + Val(SumBal(12))             ' Saldo file-den activ ve passivlerin manat ekvivalentlerinin cemi
PSheet = Cells(i, 1)                     ' Hansi Sheete yazilacaqsa onun adi
PRange = Cells(i, 2) + ":" + Cells(i, 2) ' Hansi Celse yazilacaqsa onun unvaninin Range formasinin alinmasi
